player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Agodifo {player_id} a oregoro {colour} ({piece}) wɔ Othello agoro mu.
Wo botae ne sɛ wo bɛnya wo kɔla pii sen biara wɔ agorɔdan no so bere a agoro no bɛba awiee.
Wo bere mu, fa kɔla si hɔ sɛnea ɛbɛtrɛw wo pɛpɛfo kɔla biara wɔ kwan biara (kwan a ɛyɛ pɛ, kwan a ɛyɛ kwansin, anaasɛ kwan a ɛyɛ kwankyɛn)-afei wo kɔla foforo no ne wo kɔla a wodii kan no bɛn abɔnten so. Wopɛpɛfo kɔla biara a wobɛtrɛw no bɛsesa kɔla wɔ wo dea.
Fa wo kwan a wobɛfa no wɔ '[row, col]' mu.

board.no_valid_moves_reset: {observation} Akwan a enni mu - ebia ɛsɛ sɛ wo to nsa.
board.no_valid_moves_step: {observation} Akwan a ɛmfata biara nni hɔ. Wobɛtumi aguan mu.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ɛsɛ sɛ akwantu no yɛ [row, col].

game_action.skipped: Na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔgyinafo {pid} no to ne nsa so wɔ bere a ɔnni n'asae mu.
game_action.played: Player {pid} ({piece}) dii kwan [{r}, {c}] na ɛdan {flipped} kɔla(kɔla)

game_message.must_skip: Player {pid} ({piece}) nni kwan a wobɛfa na ɛbɛyɛ sɛ wobɛdwane.
